battle_low.png:
A wide background painting for a cartoon game battle screen, seen straight on like a stage set.

The room: a torch-lit stone dungeon chamber at the base of the tower - big rough stone blocks, an arched wooden door with iron bands, a small barred window, two wall torches, wooden barrels and crates and a short flight of stone steps at the sides, flagstone floor

CRITICAL - WHERE THE FLOOR STARTS. This is the single most important requirement and the previous
attempt got it wrong, so follow it exactly:
- The image is 1280 wide and 720 tall.
- The back wall (or railing, or parapet - whatever closes off the back of the room) must END at
  400 pixels down from the top. That is slightly above the middle of the image.
- Everything below that line - the bottom 320 pixels, 44% of the picture - is FLOOR, receding
  towards the viewer. Nothing but floor: no wall, no railing, no balustrade, no steps down there.
- Characters are drawn standing with their feet on that 400-pixel line. If the wall runs lower than
  400, the characters end up floating in mid-air above the floor. That is the exact bug being fixed.
- Do not put the horizon, the railing, the wainscoting or the wall base anywhere below 400 pixels.

Leave the middle of the picture relatively plain and uncluttered - characters stand there and must stay readable.
Push the interesting detail (lanterns, doors, props, scenery) to the left and right thirds, and keep it
ABOVE the 400-pixel line so it is not covered by the characters.
No characters, no creatures, no text, no letters, no watermark, no border, no user interface.
Style: thick outlines, flat colors with soft shading, cute cartoon look, warm and slightly worn, not photorealistic.
Output 1280x720 PNG. Save the image as battle_low.png in the current directory and report the path.
